title: Passing Yards V239 Shared-Interpreter No-Purge Route
root_cause: The public exact NFL -> Passing Yards proof now reaches the V85 import graph and fails inside the deep Passing Yards module import chain. Router V187 temporarily adds nfl_ to the global V1 purge prefixes before root rendering. V225 already documents that Streamlit sessions share one interpreter and this global nfl_ purge can remove modules while another public session is using or importing them. Fresh single-process branch proof passes, while hosted shared-process proof fails.
patch: Add Router V239 over frozen V238. Only Passing Yards primes the certified V225 per-session route token, renders the existing V1 shell/selectors without mutating root._ROUTE_MODULE_PREFIXES or root._render_nfl, and imports V85 after the no-purge route is committed. Non-Passing routes delegate to V238 unchanged. app.py advances only the active router import from V238 to V239.
acceptance: app.py imports V239 and no longer imports V238 directly as the active runtime.
Passing Yards primes the V225 certified route token before the V85 import graph.
V239 never appends nfl_ to root._ROUTE_MODULE_PREFIXES.
Exact branch UI selection NFL -> Passing Yards exposes V239 and V85.
V238, V225, V187, V85, requirements and Monster sitewide owners remain byte-identical.
DevSystem final gate passes before merge.
